r_company_deposit_gates.subject: deposit_gates_scheduling
r_company_deposit_gates.content: Demo never begins without the signed contract in hand and the 25% deposit received; payment runs 25% at contract, 25% at demo start, 25% at rough-in inspection, 25% at completion.

r_company_min_job_floor.subject: min_job_floor
r_company_min_job_floor.content: Minimum job size: $15,000. Smaller leads are referred out.

r_company_margin_floor.subject: margin_floor
r_company_margin_floor.content: Gross margin floor is 30%; below that, walk.

r_company_weather_window.subject: weather_windows
r_company_weather_window.content: Foundation and framing are not scheduled between mid-December and mid-February; every outdoor-touching phase carries a 20% timeline buffer.

r_company_rock_excluded.subject: rock_excavation
r_company_rock_excluded.content: Rock excavation is always excluded from base scope; encountering rock becomes a change order, never absorbed.

r_company_no_demo_without_materials.subject: materials_before_demo
r_company_no_demo_without_materials.content: Never demo without the next phase's materials on site, and never schedule a job before the customer's final material selections are made.

r_company_local_pricing.subject: allowance_pricing
r_company_local_pricing.content: Allowance pricing from national-average retail data must be confirmed against local Tri-Cities supplier pricing before any order is placed.

r_company_interior_concurrency.subject: interior_concurrency
r_company_interior_concurrency.content: No more than two trades work concurrently inside the building; exterior trades carry no such limit.
r_company_interior_concurrency.notes: Will's rule — already enforced in generation prompts; formalized here.
